sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, to be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

This pump 
function to 
dewater the drainage water in the pit.

This document is initiated by eng. Ahmed Abdel Qader Mahmoud, tested by 
eng. Mohamed Abdel Megeed 
accepted by eng. Atty Seiffen general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed 
Abdel Baset Ahmed Rekaby: head sector of Aswan Dam 1&2 PS and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category

Maintenance staff should will trained & qualified or directly supervised by 
 some one
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل

يجب استخدام معدات السلامة والصحة مثل خوذة الأمان وأحذية السلامة ... 
 إلخ.
The pit should be dewatered.

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات
Safety and healthy equipment
Torque wrenches,
Allen key, screw driver
العمل المراد تنفيذه

Check that 
the guide bars are vertical

Change the oil (Misr 
37)

قم بتغيير الزيت 
الطريقة: ضع المضخة على جانبها فوق دعامتين.

Remove the
screw
oil and its O ring from one of the oil holes.

Turn the pump so 
that the oil hole faces downwards and remove the other oil hole screw.

Replace or fix 
worn and damaged parts.

Replacing the 
impeller: worn impeller often have very sharp edges and to replace it; remove 
nuts, impeller
المسمار، و
remove the washer then pull off the impeller.

Installing the 
impeller: 
make sure that the end of the shaft is clean and free of burns, polish-off any 
flaws.
قم بتنظيف وتزييت جميع الأسطح والحلقات.

Check the key is seated in the key way on the shaft, grease end of the shaft and 
impeller hub, place washer on the impeller screw, press the impeller on to 
the shaft with impeller screw and tight the screw
Check that the impeller is firmly seated and rotated by hand.
